title: Aetheria Labs
requirements: Crafting a premium, fluid cross-platform mobile application dedicated to guided bio-regulatory and cognitive wellness routines. The application required highly sophisticated, low-latency fluid page transitions, offline-first local data synchronization, real-time background sound mixers, and dynamic interactive ambient animations responding to user breathing rates.
achievements: Engineered premium custom physics-based UI page transitions and tactile responses inside native rendering loops
Developed offline-first data synchronization layers and background-thread sound mixers for consistent audio feedback
Optimized initial execution sequences to allow rapid load cycles across multiple mobile device generations
